_readme: Keyword rules used by scripts/auto_tag.py to SUGGEST lab tags for new
publications. Matching is a simple case-insensitive substring search
This is a blunt instrument on purpose - it's meant to catch the obvious
cases and leave the rest for a human. Add/remove terms as you notice
false positives or misses in data/suggested-tags.json.
A publication can match more than one lab; all matches are suggested.
